questions.explanation: 根据前文提到在极寒的西伯利亚冬天骑自行车穿越，大家都认为这明显是个“疯狂的(crazy)”主意。A(好的)、B(新的)、D(独特的)均不符合人们对其危险行为的评价。
questions.supplement:
A(good)：语境句：Reading is a good habit that benefits us for a lifetime. 固定搭配：do good to, be good at
B(new)：语境句：The company has developed a new strategy to attract young customers. 固定搭配：brand new, make a new start
C(crazy)：语境句：It is a crazy idea to swim across the freezing river in winter. 固定搭配：drive sb. crazy, be crazy about
D(unique)：语境句：Each individual has their own unique fingerprints. 固定搭配：be unique to, unique style

questions.explanation: 前句提到他冷得发抖，因此他可能已经被“冻伤(frost-bitten)”或极度受寒，为了取暖只能越骑越快。A(心碎的)、B(意志坚强的)、C(张口结舌的)均不符合身体受寒的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(heart-broken)：语境句：She was completely heart-broken when her pet dog passed away. 固定搭配：feel heart-broken, a heart-broken mother
B(iron-willed)：语境句：The iron-willed athlete overcame severe injuries to win the championship. 固定搭配：an iron-willed leader, iron-willed determination
C(tongue-tied)：语境句：He was so nervous during the interview that he stood there tongue-tied. 固定搭配：be tongue-tied, leave sb tongue-tied
D(frost-bitten)：语境句：The climbers' fingers were frost-bitten after days in the snowstorm. 固定搭配：frost-bitten toes, get frost-bitten

questions.explanation: 根据前句“他无法停下来”以及后文的撞车，可知这件事情的结局将会“很糟糕(badly)”。A(顺利地)、B(突然地)、D(和平地)均不符合失控即将撞车的危机感。
questions.supplement:
A(smoothly)：语境句：Thanks to everyone's effort, the project went smoothly. 固定搭配：go smoothly, run smoothly
B(suddenly)：语境句：The sky turned dark suddenly and it began to pour. 固定搭配：stop suddenly, appear suddenly
C(badly)：语境句：The building was badly damaged in the terrible earthquake. 固定搭配：be badly hurt, end badly
D(peacefully)：语境句：The old man passed away peacefully in his sleep. 固定搭配：live peacefully, solve a problem peacefully

questions.explanation: 他正骑着自行车以最高速冲下大山，flying 在此处引申为“飞驰，极速移动”，生动地描绘了失控冲下山坡的场景。A(攀爬)方向错误，C(滑雪)和D(开车)与自行车不符。
questions.supplement:
A(climbing)：语境句：We spent the whole morning climbing the steep mountain. 固定搭配：go climbing, mountain climbing
B(flying)：语境句：The boys were flying down the hill on their skateboards. 固定搭配：send sth flying, flying down (飞驰而下)
C(skiing)：语境句：They usually go skiing in the Alps during the winter holidays. 固定搭配：go skiing, water skiing
D(driving)：语境句：He is driving his new car to work today. 固定搭配：driving license, safe driving

questions.explanation: 他在骑自行车，由于在深雪的下坡路，自行车的“刹车(brakes)”已经无法让他停下来了。A(恐惧)、B(脚)、C(尖叫)不能使自行车停止。
questions.supplement:
A(fears)：语境句：She had to overcome her fears before stepping onto the stage. 固定搭配：overcome fears, live in fear
B(feet)：语境句：After walking for miles, his feet were sore and tired. 固定搭配：stand on one's own feet, drag one's feet
C(screams)：语境句：The terrifying movie was filled with screams from the audience. 固定搭配：let out a scream, hear screams
D(brakes)：语境句：He slammed on the brakes to avoid hitting the dog. 固定搭配：apply the brakes, hit the brakes

questions.explanation: 既然无法停下，他唯一能做的就是“抓紧(hang on)”。hang on tight 是固定搭配，意为“紧紧抓住”。B(闭嘴)、C(躺下)、D(环顾)在即将撞车的紧急时刻不合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(hang on)：语境句：Hang on tight as the roller coaster is about to start! 固定搭配：hang on tight, hang on a minute
B(shut up)：语境句：He rudely told his little sister to shut up. 固定搭配：shut up, keep shut up
C(lie down)：语境句：If you feel dizzy, you'd better lie down and take a rest. 固定搭配：lie down to sleep, lie down and rest
D(look round)：语境句：We had a few hours to look round the ancient city. 固定搭配：look round for sth, look round the corner

questions.explanation: 考查固定习语 in the teeth of...，字面意为“在...的牙齿里”，实际意为“迎着，冒着，在...最剧烈的时候”。此处指“在严冬的严酷中”。
questions.supplement:
A(eyes)：语境句：She looked deeply into his eyes and told the truth. 固定搭配：keep an eye on, catch one's eye
B(teeth)：语境句：He set off on his journey in the teeth of a terrible storm. 固定搭配：in the teeth of (冒着，不顾), brush one's teeth
C(head)：语境句：The successful businessman is the head of a large corporation. 固定搭配：keep one's head, lose one's head
D(back)：语境句：She carried a heavy backpack on her back during the hike. 固定搭配：turn one's back on, behind one's back

questions.explanation: 因为他孤身一人，甚至没有人能“听到(caught)”他的尖叫声。catch 此处意为“捕捉到（声音），听清”。A(回忆)、C(跟随)、D(认出)均不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(recalled)：语境句：The old man fondly recalled his childhood days in the countryside. 固定搭配：recall doing sth, recall the past
B(caught)：语境句：I didn't quite catch what you said due to the noise. 固定搭配：catch one's words, catch one's breath
C(followed)：语境句：The little dog followed the boy wherever he went. 固定搭配：follow the rules, follow one's advice
D(recognized)：语境句：I recognized her immediately by the red hat she was wearing. 固定搭配：be widely recognized, recognize sb's voice

questions.explanation: 他深处西伯利亚荒野，距离“最近的(nearest)”人类也有数百英里。表示物理距离最近，选 nearest。
questions.supplement:
A(nearest)：语境句：Could you tell me the way to the nearest hospital? 固定搭配：the nearest exit, nearest and dearest
B(kindest)：语境句：He is one of the kindest people I have ever met. 固定搭配：with kindest regards, the kindest heart
C(strongest)：语境句：Survival of the fittest means the strongest will survive. 固定搭配：the strongest candidate, in the strongest terms
D(poorest)：语境句：The charity provides food and shelter for the poorest families. 固定搭配：the poorest regions, the poorest quality

questions.explanation: 伴随着“CRASH(撞击)”，他脸朝下“摔落/着陆(landed)”进了一个雪堆。land 在此作动词表示“降落，跌落到地上”。
questions.supplement:
A(pushed)：语境句：He pushed the heavy door open and walked into the room. 固定搭配：push forward, push aside
B(stood)：语境句：The brave soldier stood firmly at his post despite the cold. 固定搭配：stand out, stand for
C(landed)：语境句：The plane landed safely at the airport despite the heavy fog. 固定搭配：land on one's feet, safely landed
D(slid)：语境句：The glass slid off the table and crashed onto the floor. 固定搭配：slide down, slide into

questions.explanation: 经历惨烈摔倒后，起初的一两分钟他没动，他甚至不确定自己是否还“活着(alive)”。
questions.supplement:
A(alive)：语境句：It was a miracle that the passengers were found alive after the crash. 固定搭配：keep alive, come alive
B(awake)：语境句：The strong coffee kept me awake all night. 固定搭配：stay awake, wide awake
C(healthy)：语境句：Eating plenty of vegetables and fruits helps you stay healthy. 固定搭配：stay healthy, a healthy diet
D(broken)：语境句：She carefully swept up the pieces of the broken vase. 固定搭配：a broken heart, broken English

questions.explanation: 他慢慢活动了脚趾、手指和鼻子，发现所有的身体部位都“完好无损/在原位(in place)”，即没有骨折或残缺。
questions.supplement:
A(place)：语境句：Make sure everything is in place before the guests arrive. 固定搭配：in place (就位，妥当), take place
B(touch)：语境句：We promised to keep in touch after graduating from high school. 固定搭配：keep in touch, lose touch
C(trouble)：语境句：If you don't follow the rules, you will get into trouble. 固定搭配：in trouble, ask for trouble
D(sight)：语境句：The majestic mountains finally came into sight. 固定搭配：out of sight, catch sight of

questions.explanation: 前文提到他安然无恙，是因为厚厚的积雪缓冲了他的“摔落(fall)”。cushion one's fall 意为“缓冲跌倒的力量”。
questions.supplement:
A(fall)：语境句：The thick snow on the ground cushioned his fall. 固定搭配：cushion one's fall, break one's fall
B(jump)：语境句：With a sudden jump, the cat caught the mouse. 固定搭配：high jump, jump to conclusions
C(dig)：语境句：They had to dig a deep hole to plant the tree. 固定搭配：dig into, dig up
D(rub)：语境句：He had to rub his freezing hands together to keep warm. 固定搭配：rub shoulders with, rub off

questions.explanation: 趴在冰冷的雪里不舒服，因此他慢慢地把自己“拉起/撑起(pulled)”。pull oneself upright 是常见搭配，意为“挣扎着站直”。
questions.supplement:
A(dressed)：语境句：She got up early, washed, and dressed quickly for work. 固定搭配：get dressed, be dressed in
B(hurt)：语境句：He accidentally hurt his leg while playing basketball. 固定搭配：feel hurt, badly hurt
C(pulled)：语境句：He pulled himself upright and continued to walk despite the pain. 固定搭配：pull up, pull oneself together
D(behaved)：语境句：The children behaved very well at the party. 固定搭配：behave well, behave oneself

questions.explanation: 根据后半句“that I've ridden down today（我今天骑下的）”以及上文44题提到“flying down a big hill”，可知他今天在每个骑下坡的“山丘(hill)”上都摔倒了。
questions.supplement:
A(snowdrift)：语境句：The car was completely stuck in a huge snowdrift. 固定搭配：deep snowdrift, stuck in a snowdrift
B(bike)：语境句：He rides his bike to school every day to stay fit. 固定搭配：ride a bike, mountain bike
C(road)：语境句：The road to success is often filled with difficulties. 固定搭配：on the road, hit the road
D(hill)：语境句：They stood at the top of the hill, looking down at the village. 固定搭配：up the hill, over the hill

section_2_word_form.passage:
With a pair of scissors, a couple of rubber bands and ribbons, Liang Qinzhang can turn twigs (细枝), branches and flowers into pieces of art.
The man in his 60s demonstrated traditional flower arrangement for gardening [56] (enthusiast) in Beijing during the Spring Festival in late January 2023. "As Chinese tradition goes, I use magnolias (木兰), [57] blossoms bring good fortune, to show harmony and happiness," Liang explained. "Since ancient times, different materials [58] (apply) to create a grand effect for special occasions." At the end of the session, Liang hung festive items on the plants [59] (highlight) the holiday atmosphere and suggested his audience do the same.
Liang held the demonstration in [60] belief that it should be easy for the traditional art, [61] (name) a national intangible (非物质的) cultural heritage in 2008, to be enjoyed by more people. "It places more focus [62] the expression of moods and the personalized meaning of the materials used," he said.
"Chinese flower arrangement is influenced by traditional Chinese culture and tends to be about [63] (nature) beauty, rather than artificial creation," Liang said. "Therefore, we need to go out more often to observe plants and [64] (far) understand the ecological habits of the flowering branches, through which we can know how to better arrange [65] (they)."

questions.explanation: enthusiast（爱好者）为可数名词，在此处泛指园艺爱好者这一群体，且前面没有不定冠词，故需使用复数形式 enthusiasts。
questions.supplement: 正确形(enthusiasts)：语境句：The classic car show attracted thousands of enthusiasts from all over the country. 固定搭配：sports enthusiasts, car enthusiasts。原词enthusiast其它变形：enthusiasm(n. 热情), enthusiastic(adj. 热情的), enthusiastically(adv. 热情地)。

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构可知，逗号后为非限制性定语从句，修饰先行词 magnolias（木兰）。从句中 blossoms 作主语，与先行词为所属关系（木兰的花朵），故填关系代词 whose。
questions.supplement: 正确形(whose)：语境句：The author, whose latest book became a bestseller, will give a speech tomorrow. 固定搭配：whose name is, a person whose...。原词who其它变形：whom(pron. 宾格), whoever(pron. 无论谁)。

questions.explanation: 句中时间状语为 "Since ancient times"，谓语动词需用现在完成时。主语 materials 与 apply（应用）之间为被动关系，因此使用现在完成时的被动语态 have been applied。
questions.supplement: 正确形(have been applied)：语境句：These strict rules have been applied to all employees since last year. 固定搭配：apply to (适用于), apply for (申请)。原词apply其它变形：application(n. 申请/应用), applicant(n. 申请人), applicable(adj. 适用的)。

questions.explanation: 梁在植物上挂节日物品的“目的”是为了突出节日气氛，在句中作目的状语，应使用动词不定式 to highlight。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to highlight)：语境句：The teacher used colorful slides to highlight the main points of the lesson. 固定搭配：highlight the importance, a major highlight。原词highlight其它变形：highlights(n. 精彩部分), highlighted(adj. 突出的)。

questions.explanation: 考查冠词及固定搭配。in the belief that... 为固定表达，意为“相信/怀着……的信念”，后接同位语从句，需用定冠词 the。
questions.supplement: 正确形(the)：语境句：She worked hard in the belief that her efforts would eventually pay off. 固定搭配：in the belief that (相信...), hold the belief。定冠词the其它常见搭配：the same as, the number of。

questions.explanation: 分析句子可知，空处在句中作后置定语，修饰 traditional art。name 与 traditional art 构成逻辑上的动宾被动关系（被命名为），故使用过去分词 named。
questions.supplement: 正确形(named)：语境句：The local museum, named after a famous scientist, is open to the public for free. 固定搭配：be named after, namely (adv. 即)。原词name其它变形：namely(adv. 也就是), nameless(adj. 无名的)。

questions.explanation: 考查介词。place/put focus on... 是固定搭配，意为“把焦点放在……上 / 重点关注……”，故填 on。
questions.supplement: 正确形(on)：语境句：Nowadays, schools place more focus on students' mental health. 固定搭配：focus on (关注), place focus on (把焦点放在...上)。其它常见介词搭配：depend on, rely on。

questions.explanation: 空处修饰名词 beauty（美），需将其转换为形容词形式 natural，表示“自然的美（natural beauty）”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(natural)：语境句：The national park is famous for its stunning natural beauty. 固定搭配：natural beauty, natural resources。原词nature其它变形：naturally(adv. 自然地), unnatural(adj. 不自然的)。

questions.explanation: 空处修饰动词 understand，意为“进一步理解”，需使用 far 的抽象副词比较级形式 further。
questions.supplement: 正确形(further)：语境句：If you need any further information, please feel free to contact us. 固定搭配：further study, go a step further。原词far其它变形：farther(adv./adj. 物理距离更远), farthest/furthest(adv./adj. 最远)。

questions.explanation: 空处作动词 arrange（布置）的宾语，指代前文的 plants / flowering branches（复数名词），需用代词的宾格形式 them。
questions.supplement: 正确形(them)：语境句：The books are heavy, so please handle them with care. 固定搭配：arrange them, look after them。原词they其它变形：their(pron. 他们的), theirs(pron. 名词性物主代词), themselves(pron. 他们自己)。
